name: Makeup All Stars [NEW THEMES]💄
desc:
Welcome to Makeup All Stars!

Paint your own makeup looks, customise your hair and lashes, and compete in themed beauty battles. Vote for your favourite creations, earn rewards and unlock new beauty items.

This game was built to work well and be easy to play on all device types! 

Join our community for updates and sneak peeks 
https://www.roblox.com/share/g/1059168721

passes.name: Unlock ALL Level Locked Items + VIP 🔓

llm.loop: enter themed round -> paint makeup on a face, style hair and lashes -> players vote -> earn coins -> unlock beauty items
llm.instructions: paint makeup looks, customise hair and lashes, compete and vote
unique: detailed face makeup painting instead of whole-outfit dress-up
llm.thumbnails: realistic bald face before/after makeup and hair transformation
llm.complexity_notes: face painting system on a realistic head, hair/lash assets, voting rounds
